title: SQL injection in search endpoint
description: Parameter q appears injectable; backend error responses differ for quote vs normal input.
evidence: 500 with "syntax error at or near \"'\"" when q=' ; 200 for q=shirt
remediation: Use parameterized queries; enforce allowlist validation for q; remove verbose DB errors.

title: Reflected XSS via returnUrl parameter
description: Input reflected into HTML without encoding on the login page when returnUrl contains angle brackets.
remediation: HTML-encode untrusted input and validate returnUrl against an allowlist of internal paths.

title: Session cookie missing SameSite attribute
description: Session cookie lacks SameSite; increases CSRF exposure in some browser contexts.
remediation: Set SameSite=Lax or Strict on session cookies; ensure compatibility with auth flows.

title: Password reset token not validated for user
description: Reset endpoint accepts token without binding it to the account being reset.
evidence: Changing email in JSON still resets when using token issued for another address
remediation: Bind reset tokens to a user id; verify token audience and expiry; rate-limit attempts.

title: CORS allows credentialed requests from arbitrary origins
description: Access-Control-Allow-Origin reflects Origin and Access-Control-Allow-Credentials is true.
evidence: ACAO: https://evil.example and ACAC: true observed with Origin header
remediation: Use a strict allowlist for origins; avoid credentialed CORS unless required.

title: Server header reveals version
description: Responses include detailed Server header exposing reverse proxy version.
remediation: Remove or generalize server version headers at the edge proxy.

title: Account statements accessible by incremental id
description: Statement PDF endpoint uses numeric id without authorization checks; other users' statements can be fetched.
evidence: Authenticated as user A, request to /api/statements/184233.pdf returns 200 for user B
remediation: Enforce object-level authorization on statement access; use opaque identifiers.

title: Open redirect via next parameter
description: next parameter accepts absolute URLs and redirects without validation.
remediation: Allowlist internal redirect targets; reject absolute URLs and scheme-relative URLs.

title: TLS 1.0 supported
description: Server negotiates TLS 1.0 for some clients.
evidence: Handshake accepted with TLSv1.0; cipher ECDHE-RSA-AES128-SHA
remediation: Disable TLS 1.0/1.1 and weak ciphers; prefer TLS 1.2+ only.

title: Robots.txt discloses admin paths
description: robots.txt lists sensitive paths that may aid discovery.
remediation: Avoid listing sensitive endpoints; rely on authz and do not expose internal paths.

title: SSRF in webhook URL validator
description: Webhook test feature fetches user-supplied URLs; internal addresses appear reachable.
evidence: POST url=http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/ returned 200 with EC2 metadata keys
remediation: Block private/metadata IP ranges; enforce egress allowlist; use DNS pinning protections.

title: State-changing POST lacks CSRF protection
description: POST /settings/email succeeds without CSRF token and accepts cookie-based auth.
evidence: POST without CSRF token returns 200 and updates email preferences
remediation: Add CSRF tokens or SameSite+double-submit pattern; verify Origin/Referer on sensitive actions.

title: Missing X-Frame-Options header
description: Pages can be framed; may enable UI redress attacks.
evidence: No X-Frame-Options or CSP frame-ancestors directive present
remediation: Set X-Frame-Options DENY/SAMEORIGIN or CSP frame-ancestors to restrict framing.

title: Content-Security-Policy not set
description: No CSP header observed on main application responses.
remediation: Implement a CSP appropriate to the app; start in report-only to reduce breakage.

title: Velocity template injection in preview endpoint
description: Template preview evaluates user input; crafted payload executes commands in sandboxed worker.
remediation: Treat templates as data; disable dangerous directives; use safe rendering engine/allowlist.

title: Possible XXE in invoice upload parser
description: XML upload endpoint appears to expand external entities; response timing changes when referencing remote DTD.
evidence: Request with DOCTYPE and external SYSTEM caused delayed response vs baseline
remediation: Disable external entity resolution; use secure XML parser settings; validate content type.

title: Directory listing enabled on /assets/
description: Web server lists directory contents for static assets path.
evidence: Index of /assets/ shows build artifacts and source maps
remediation: Disable autoindex/directory listing; restrict access to internal build artifacts.

title: Email addresses exposed in HTML comments
description: Support addresses appear in HTML comments on public pages.
evidence: "<!-- reach ops at oncall@ironcladbenefits.com -->" in page source
remediation: Remove sensitive comments from HTML templates; keep contacts in visible content only.

title: Role check missing on admin export endpoint
description: Non-admin users can trigger exports; response contains job id and downloadable CSV link.
evidence: User with role=analyst received 202 with export job id and signed URL
remediation: Enforce server-side role checks; restrict export routes; audit access logs.
